python3 -c '
import subprocess, re, collections

out = subprocess.run(["git","rev-list","--objects","--all"], cwd="/opt/weather-pipeline/repo",
                      capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
lines = out.strip().split("\n")

patterns = {
    "forecast_video*.mp4": re.compile(r"forecast_video.*\.mp4$"),
    "blocks_gemini/tmp/*.mp4": re.compile(r"blocks_gemini/tmp/.*\.mp4$"),
    "audio/*.mp3 + forecast_*.mp3": re.compile(r"(audio/.*\.mp3$|forecast_.*\.mp3$|blocks_gemini/.*\.mp3$)"),
    "ensemble_snapshots_*.json": re.compile(r"ensemble_snapshots_.*\.json$"),
    "eumetsat_*_log.json / *_buffer.npz": re.compile(r"eumetsat_.*(log\.json|buffer\.npz)$"),
    "model_forecast_cache.json": re.compile(r"model_forecast_cache\.json$"),
    "marine_history.json": re.compile(r"marine_history\.json$"),
    "pws_raw.json": re.compile(r"pws_raw\.json$"),
    "modeldata/*.json": re.compile(r"modeldata/.*\.json$"),
    "anim/*.png + *.mp4": re.compile(r"anim/.*\.(png|mp4)$"),
    "bufr_*.json": re.compile(r"bufr_.*\.json$"),
}

# build sha -> path map (may have multiple paths per sha across history, but rev-list --objects gives sha path pairs at least once per unique blob-path combo)
sha_path = []
for l in lines:
    parts = l.split(" ", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        sha_path.append((parts[0], parts[1]))

# batch-check sizes
batch_input = "\n".join(s for s,p in sha_path) + "\n"
p = subprocess.run(["git","cat-file","--batch-check=%(objectname) %(objectsize)"],
                    cwd="/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", input=batch_input, capture_output=True, text=True)
sizes = {}
for l in p.stdout.strip().split("\n"):
    parts = l.split()
    if len(parts) == 2:
        sizes[parts[0]] = int(parts[1])

totals = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0,0])
other_total = [0,0]
matched_shas = set()
for sha, path in sha_path:
    sz = sizes.get(sha, 0)
    matched = False
    for name, pat in patterns.items():
        if pat.search(path):
            totals[name][0] += sz
            totals[name][1] += 1
            matched = True
            matched_shas.add(sha)
            break
    if not matched:
        other_total[0] += sz
        other_total[1] += 1

print(f"Total unique (sha,path) pairs: {len(sha_path)}")
print(f"Total unique blobs: {len(set(s for s,p in sha_path))}")
grand = 0
for name, (sz, cnt) in sorted(totals.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][0]):
    print(f"{name:45s} count={cnt:6d} total={sz/1024/1024:9.1f} MiB")
    grand += sz
print(f"{'"'"'OTHER (everything else)'"'"':45s} count={other_total[1]:6d} total={other_total[0]/1024/1024:9.1f} MiB")
print(f"GRAND TOTAL matched categories: {grand/1024/1024:.1f} MiB")
'
